purpose: Requirements for the evaluator agent in the review mechanism: independently verifying reviewer findings using meta-perspectives, rejecting wrong findings, and stating root causes via evaluations.
summary: Evaluator independently judges reviewer findings and returns evaluations with dispositions
Defines the meta-perspective term and the five meta-perspectives (FNC-201) for doubting root causes and source information
Evaluator reads from the finding outward rather than reading the whole target
Target type determination and per-type documents reuse the reviewer rules
Evaluator may newly report reviewer oversights with valid disposition and script-assigned finding_id (FNC-206)
Output rules: write evaluations only after all judgments are finalized; zero evaluations is allowed (FNC-209)
Evaluator has no error values; only exit value "0" (FNC-319)
Evaluator input is the request plus findings, with no combined input file (DM-202)
Shared exchange contract is delegated to REQ-029; open item TBD-001 on verifying meta-perspective effectiveness
tasks: Reviewing or modifying the evaluator agent definition
Implementing evaluator behavior in the review mechanism
Deciding disposition values for reviewer findings
Designing how evaluators report new findings
Reviewing requirement documents on the review mechanism
Defining evaluator error handling and exit values
title: REQ-026 evaluator の独立評価とメタ観点 要件定義書
